sources.snippet: Refrigerator AI Refrigerator AI is an experimental project that incorporates a large-scale language model (LLM) into a refrigerator, enabling conversation and recipe suggestions. A lightweight Japanese LLM running on a Raspberry Pi 4 with 4GB RAM is used to provide simple conversations and information.
